slot_invariant: A/B/C only; a new authorized worker must take over an existing slot by durable handoff and can never create slot 4

responsibilities: dispatch exactly one smallest authorized packet
maintain Taiwan-time deadline and progress surfaces
metabolize duplicate/transient control-plane metadata without touching user chat history or protected evidence

LCR-B.handoff_source: durable state + pending packet + lease + packet hash

takeover_candidate.declared_role: Secondary Integrator / Metabolic Maintainer / Independent Verifier
takeover_candidate.rule: if this worker modified the current candidate, it cannot verify that same candidate; assign verification to the other independent C implementation/run

required: lease null/expired or explicit same-slot transfer
previous active worker yields write authority before replacement writes
handoff_protocol.on_success: replace active_worker in the same slot; preserve durable state; old worker becomes STANDBY
handoff_protocol.on_failure: no takeover; no fourth slot; quarantine conflicting report and keep current active worker

continuity_rule: user messages and collaborator reports are external control events; they must not reset or cancel unrelated active B/C work. Only a valid durable handoff changes slot ownership.

self_metabolism_boundary.allowed: dedupe/compact/TTL/disposition for LCR-created transient control-plane metadata, duplicate progress/event envelopes and reproducible scratch
self_metabolism_boundary.forbidden: delete or rewrite user chat history, platform-hidden model context, secrets, protected evidence, rollback anchors, stable state, Identity Kernel, personality or Governance
